:::{#exm-shape-rule-undefined}
#### A product that the shape rule rules out

<!-- no-figure: the example works with shapes only, so there are no values to plot -->

Let $\matr{A}$ be $2 \times 3$ and let $\matr{B}$ be $3 \times 4$.
The [product](#def-matrix-mult) $\matr{B}\matr{A}$ is $(3 \times 4)(2 \times 3)$.
Its inner pair $4, 2$ does not match,
so the [shape rule](#def-shape-rule) says that $\matr{B}\matr{A}$ is not defined,
although $\matr{A}\matr{B}$ is.

:::
